statement.zh: 低地两河冲积平原是早期城市、文字行政与国家社会的核心考古—历史研究区；本条以南部苏美尔/乌鲁克为中心。
statement.en: Lowland Mesopotamia (Tigris–Euphrates alluvium) is a core region for early cities, administrative writing, and state societies; this entry centers southern Sumer/Uruk developments.
